description: Compute a multi-stop Great Circle itinerary across 2 to 8 airport waypoints across 15 aircraft profiles, returning leg-by-leg distances, headings, range feasibility, cumulative & per-cabin CO2, circuityRatio vs nonstop, 110m sovereign polygon overflight, and solar window-seat guidance.

aircraft.description: Optional aircraft profile ID, alias, or short name among 15 profiles. Defaults to Boeing 747-8.

cabin.description: Optional cabin class for per-passenger CO2 scaling. Defaults to economy.

departure_preset.description: Optional departure window for multi-leg solar window-seat analysis. Defaults to morning.

waypoints.description: Ordered array of 2-8 3-letter IATA airport codes (e.g. ["JFK", "LHR", "DXB", "SIN"]).

name: calculate_multi_leg_route
